title: 14. Numeracy & Number Systems: Single-Digit Multiplication Facts
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.question: What is \(6\times 7\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(6\times 7\) means \(6\) groups of \(7\). Adding \(7\) six times gives \(7+7+7+7+7+7=42\). Therefore, \(6\times 7=42\).
questions.hint: Think of \(6\) groups of \(7\) or use a known multiplication fact.

questions.question: What is \(8\times 9\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(8\times 9\) means \(8\) groups of \(9\). Adding \(9\) eight times gives \(72\), or use the known fact \(8\times 9=72\). Therefore, the product is \(72\).
questions.hint: Use repeated addition or a multiplication table.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a word problem using the multiplication fact \(4\times 8\).
questions.question: A box has \(4\) rows of \(8\) stickers. How many stickers are in the box?
questions.explanation: There are \(4\) equal rows with \(8\) stickers in each row. Multiply the number of rows by the number in each row: \(4\times 8=32\). Therefore, there are \(32\) stickers.
questions.hint: Multiply the number of rows by the number of stickers in each row.

questions.question: What is \(9\times 7\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(9\times 7\) means \(9\) groups of \(7\). Use a nearby fact: \(10\times 7=70\), and one group of \(7\) fewer gives \(70-7=63\). Therefore, \(9\times 7=63\).
questions.hint: Use a known multiplication fact or repeated addition.

questions.question: What is \(5\times 6\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(5\times 6\) means \(5\) groups of \(6\). Adding \(6\) five times gives \(6+6+6+6+6=30\). Therefore, \(5\times 6=30\).
questions.hint: Count by \(6\) five times or use a multiplication fact.

questions.question: What is \(7\times 8\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(7\times 8\) means \(7\) groups of \(8\). Split the groups: \(5\times 8=40\) and \(2\times 8=16\), so \(40+16=56\). Therefore, \(7\times 8=56\).
questions.hint: Split the \(7\) groups of \(8\) into \(5\) groups of \(8\) and \(2\) groups of \(8\), then add the two products.

questions.question: What is \(3\times 9\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(3\times 9\) means \(3\) groups of \(9\). Adding \(9\) three times gives \(9+9+9=27\). Therefore, \(3\times 9=27\).
questions.hint: Add \(9\) three times or use a known fact.

questions.question: What is \(9\times 9\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(9\times 9\) means \(9\) groups of \(9\). Use a nearby fact: \(10\times 9=90\), and one group of \(9\) fewer gives \(90-9=81\). Therefore, \(9\times 9=81\).
questions.hint: Start from \(10\times 9\) and take away one group of \(9\).

questions.question: What is \(6\times 8\)?
questions.explanation: The multiplication fact \(6\times 8\) means \(6\) groups of \(8\). Adding \(8\) six times gives \(48\), or use the known fact \(6\times 8=48\). Therefore, the product is \(48\).
questions.hint: Use repeated addition or a multiplication fact.

questions.learningObjective: Solve a word problem using the multiplication fact \(6\times 9\).
questions.question: A bag has \(6\) packs of marbles. Each pack has \(9\) marbles. How many marbles are in the bag?
questions.explanation: There are \(6\) equal packs, and each pack has \(9\) marbles. Multiply the number of packs by the number of marbles in each pack: \(6\times 9=54\). Therefore, there are \(54\) marbles in the bag.
questions.hint: Multiply the number of packs by the number of marbles in each pack.
